recurrence: Four hours after documented health-event acknowledgement; ordinary activity and unrelated acknowledgements do not reset the clock.
delivery_limits: Due on the next 60-second scan; active owner defers routine delivery until idle. One outstanding batch remains enforced; sleeping/offline workstation and uncertain transport can delay delivery.
rollback: Cancel and wait for watcher exit; restore retained pre-change watcher/configuration, then resume under the same owner without changing the event database or scientific processes.
